policy: Unknown source-format semantics remain hypotheses until controlled edits from a verified editor/export falsify alternatives. Never infer exact semantics from names alone.

experiments.unknown: XML document order vs numeric frame ID vs playback order
hypotheses: IDs are stable addresses and separate ordering exists
experiments.experiment: Create three visibly distinct poses in a verified editor, save, use a controlled frame reorder/duplicate/delete, save again and compare XML sequence, IDs and exported video sequence.

experiments.unknown: Exact meaning and units of interframes
experiments.experiment: On reversible copies, alter only the field through an authorized editor if possible; compare stored pose count, output duration, exported frames and tween samples.
Use a self-authored three-level rig; translate root without moving child-local geometry then move one parent and compare saved coordinates and rendered landmarks.
In a self-authored scene, attach/detach a slave point to a master and separately transform the parent; record saved topology and rendered motion.
Alter one weight, offset or flip at a time in a self-authored two-segment asset and compare landmark positions and raster diff.
Create two named ranges, change one period/loop field at a time and measure exported duration and cycle-boundary pose difference.
Keep a character and background landmarks fixed, pan/zoom camera, then move background alone; compare screen-space transforms and exported pixels.

hypotheses: Custom easing sampled from control points
experiments.experiment: Create numbered-frame markers and a two-point speed change in a verified editor; compare marker source-frame IDs against output timestamps.

acceptance: A proposed rule must predict repeated results across at least three controlled operations and cite the source/project hash and exported-frame observations.
data_policy: Metadata and aggregate features only. No raw proprietary source project archives, character media, audio, APK or DEX payloads are included.
